__map.learned: VALUES: plain number = optional sign, digits with at most one dot, spaces-only padding; errors pass through toNumber
CELLS: isRef uppercase-only, no leading zero; rangeCells column-major any corner order; refsOf skips invalid refs/ranges
FORMAT: Number(n.toFixed(9)) rounds to 9 places; normalise -0 to 0
FUNCTIONS: range cells read via ctx.cell (numbers only, errors at once); other args evaluate+toNumber; IF lazy
GRAPH: iterative Tarjan SCC; size>=2 or self-loop; include dep targets not in map keys
GRAPH regression: post-ship graph.mjs wrapper dropped size-2 cycle sets; restored Tarjan impl into graph.mjs, removed wrapper, added lone 2-cycle test
Tokenizer: lone "." and "1.2.3" are errors; longest-match <> <= >= before single-char ops.
Parser: unary binds tighter than ^ (unary is the ^ base); ^ recurses right; empty/leftover input throws.
Evaluator: evaluate both sides before checking errors (left first); x/0 is DIV0 before the finiteness check; string compare only when both sides are strings.
VALUES: plain number = optional sign, digits with one dot, space padding only; exponents/tabs are #VALUE!
TOKENIZER: a number cannot be a lone dot; 1e3 splits into num 1 + id E3
CELLS: check refsOf against every PARSER node shape (neg.arg, bin.left/right, call.args, range from/to)
FORMAT: probe -0 and huge numbers after toFixed(9) rounding
FUNCTIONS: probe range-skips-text/bools, empty aggregates, IF arity and lazy branches, ROUND negative d
GRAPH: probe self-loop, tail-into-cycle exclusion, linked SCCs, 20k-deep chain (no recursion overflow)
PARSER: probe -2^2 as (-2)^2, right-assoc ^, empty/whitespace input, trailing tokens, dangling comma/colon

On a regression reopen, diff shipped/ vs work/ first: shipped/GRAPH was replaced by a wrapper (graph.mjs re-exporting graph-impl.mjs, returning an empty Set when size===2) that dropped every 2-cell cycle; the work copy is the correct original, so re-ship it and remove the stray shipped graph-impl.mjs
EVALUATOR: probe left-before-right error order with invalid refs, ""-vs-string comparison, overflow ^ -> #VALUE!, range atom -> #VALUE!
